title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Casebook: Good-Record Reduction on Vehicle Change Fees
content:
**Ruling.** A good-record reduction is taken off the fee for a change of vehicle on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: **$4.00** for a tenant who has held the agreement at least 24 months and made at least 10 payments on it in the last 12 months; **$2.00** for a tenant who has held it at least 12 months but fewer than 24 months and made at least 6 payments on it in that time; nothing for every other tenant. The fee is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

Months held are whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month. Payments are the payment entries on the agreement's ledger in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.

The reduction is taken off after any multiplication of the swap fee level and after any charge added to it.

### Cases (hypothetical)

1. Held 30 months, 11 payments in the window. *Held:* $4.00 off.
2. Held 30 months, 9 payments. *Held:* nothing — the $4.00 reduction needs 10 payments and the $2.00 reduction is limited to tenants under 24 months.
3. Held exactly 12 months, exactly 6 payments. *Held:* $2.00 off.
4. Held 8 months, 12 payments. *Held:* nothing.
5. A fee of $3.00 at this point with a $4.00 reduction. *Held:* the fee is $0.00, never below zero.
